answer: New identities enter only through stake-backed vouching, and the trust graph is audited as a voyage: random walks start from established members and measure how thin the thread is between a newcomer cluster and the honest core. A sybil farm links densely inside itself but connects to the real network through only a few bought edges, so its min-cut is tiny and the walk rarely escapes the hollow echo chamber. Each fake identity needs its own genuine vouchers, and a caught voucher loses its stake, so the cost of N puppets is N separate bribes, while an honest newcomer pays one introduction.
